$comment: Roles and permissions in Blocks OS IAM (functions/admin/ops/iam/*). Additive: Workspace.IamOrganizationId holds the id of the IAM organization that mirrors the workspace (written by iam.sync.run and iam.access.set; read only by the iam.* ops). PlatformSetting keys (validations.json Key enum): rbac.source ("factory" | "iam", default "factory" when absent), iam.sync (the last check and sync) and iam.parity (the last parity check result). Apply expand-first BEFORE deploying the functions or the web app.

fields.name: IamOrganizationId
fields.description: Id of the Blocks OS IAM organization that mirrors this workspace (set by the IAM sync).
